svg.title: Data model: platform
svg.text: One PostgreSQL database, text only; every row belongs to one customer, with row-level security. It is the backup, syncs the family’s phones and restores the metadata if the home box is replaced.
No table holds images, fingerprints or biometric data: member has the name, the role and the consent record; fingerprints and face templates exist only on the home device.
Proposed retention: events and people seen, 30 days; alerts and actions, 90 days.
Lines: 1 and N say how many records on each side. Foreign keys without a line are written in the field (→ table).
